Power Station | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, ... etc.
Surge Arrester out of service.

Tools and Equipment
Rags, 
 Fiberglass ladder
Voltage 
 indicator, Thermo vision gun
Check that there is no voltage, clean the 
 insulators of Surge Arrestor.
Check 
 insulators for cracks.
Put the 
 Surge Arrester into service and carry out 
 thermo 
 vision test for hotspot for its connection with network.
